title: Audio_Builder car audio parts: Wiring kits
attribution: Audio_Builder car audio parts database, Wiring kits (CC BY 4.0); values (numbers only) credited to the maker page in each record's sources
method: Maker product pages, maker store data and manuals (tier maker / maker-store); numbers only. Prices and records built from retailer listings are not in the public copy. Research: references/research_i_car_electronics.md (R3_ELECTRONICS, R3B_PARTS_CLEAN, 2026-11-23). Records marked auto-parsed in `check` are unverified until checked against the maker manual.
corrections: Corrections go in data/parts_raw/wiring_kits/<brand>.json (with the source URL and date); then run node scripts/import_parts.mjs.

brands.terms_note: Numbers only, URL per record; USD maker-store prices.
Numbers only with URL. Rockford accessory pages have no spec table.
